parameters.formDescription: Solo personal. Registra entradas de mercancia, devoluciones, ajustes por conteo y mermas. Cada movimiento queda en el kardex (Inventory_Movements).

nodes.name: Plan stock movement
nodes.notes: Why Code: validates the movement (existing SKU, positive quantity, stock never below zero), computes the weighted average cost for purchase receipts and decides if a purchase request is fully or partially received.

parameters.formDescription: Solo personal. Cancela un pedido que no se ha entregado: devuelve el stock, cancela la factura, libera al repartidor y avisa al cliente.

nodes.name: Plan cancellation
nodes.notes: Why Code: finds the order, its invoice, open delivery, rider and customer; parses the items of the order and works out the new stock of each product. Delivered or already cancelled orders are rejected.

nodes.name: Split restock lines
nodes.notes: Why Code: turns the restock array into one item per product so the Sheets nodes update each product.

nodes.name: Back to one item
nodes.notes: Why Code: after the per-product updates, continues with one item carrying the cancellation plan.
